mission: Put your own title text on the clip, say what you want it to say, and make it look different from the plain default. Export it.

checkpoints.check: state.elements.some(x => x.category === 'Text Elements' && x.label !== 'Enter text here' && x.label.trim() !== '')
checkpoints.describe: A title with the user's own words is on the clip

checkpoints.check: state.elements.some(x => x.category === 'Text Elements' && x.style && Object.keys(x.style).some(k => ['italic','font','weight','fill','stroke','shadow','size','background'].includes(k) && x.style[k] !== undefined && x.style[k] !== null && x.style[k] !== '' && !(k === 'font' && x.style[k] === 'Fredoka One')))
checkpoints.describe: The title's look differs from the default (font, weight, italic, colour, outline, shadow, size or background)

why.data: Text adds +45.9 export points for heavy editors; restyling is a heavy-editor trait.
